per_view.notes: Slender fuselage with clear front hump reading as 747. Engine nacelles are bunched near the wing root/belly rather than spread inboard/outboard on pylons, and cluster into a blocky mass. Nose gear and multi-bogie main gear visible. Tall navy swept fin present. Light-grey body with grey wings is coherent. Window band along main deck.

Slender white fuselage with front upper-deck hump and blue swept fin plus horizontal stabilizer read as a 747. Window/cheatline present. Near wing swept but slab-like and dark. Engines are an indistinct dark cluster over the wing root, not four clear underslung nacelles. Wheel clusters visible for gear. Wing-fuselage junction looks cluttered.

Head-on: four dark nacelles, two per swept wing with plausible spacing. Grey fuselage, bulbous rounded nose with slight crown bump reading as modest hump. Tall thin blue vertical fin, thin horizontal stabilizer line. Cluster of nose+main gear wheels under belly. No visible window/door bands; only faint cockpit hint. Clean assembly.

Rear head-on: four engine pods hung two per swept wing with dihedral. Tall dark-blue vertical fin plus thin horizontal stabilizers. Rounded grey fuselage with faint crown bump. Clustered black main-gear bogies below body. No window or door detail visible from this angle; livery grey with blue tail.

Four dark-inlet nacelles, two per swept tapering wing, sit close to leading edge with modest forward offset. Slender white fuselage with tapered nose/tail cone. Front-crown hump patch reads as upper deck. Swept fin and tailplane at tail with blue stripe. Only a small upper-deck window patch; main-deck window line barely visible.

Four grey nacelles under swept tapered wings, some sitting close to belly. Slender white fuselage, tapered nose/tail, modest front hump. Tall dark-blue swept fin plus horizontal stabilizers. Blue cheatline with window dots. Nose gear and partial main gear present but sparse and slightly floating.

Slender white fuselage with a front upper-deck hump reads well. Swept tapering grey wings, tall blue vertical fin plus horizontal stabilizers present. Window line and blue cheatline visible. No underwing engine nacelles are visible at all. Dark wheel clusters bunched centrally under the belly rather than in proper main-gear trucks.

Slender grey fuselage with tapered nose and swept dihedral wings; tall blue swept fin plus horizontal stabilizers read well. Nose and multi-truck main gear visible. Engines cluster near belly/fuselage rather than spread cleanly under wings, and the forward hump reads as a blocky raised box. Dark dashed window line present; no upper-deck windows.

Slender white fuselage with tapering nose, swept dihedral wings, tall dark-blue fin and horizontal stabilizers. Underwing nacelles on pylons (four plausible). Nose gear plus main trucks visible. Dark window band and cockpit triangle. Hump is a small rounded block just behind nose, reads slightly separate/short.

critic.fix_suggestion: Improve 'Window and door lines' (mean 5.22/10). Target the 8 anchor: a consistent passenger-window line along the main deck plus cockpit windows, door hints; then the 10 anchor: clean main-deck window line, separate upper-deck windows on the hump, cockpit windshield shape, evenly spaced doors.
